scheme_name: Cost of Hearing Aid for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal
Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must pay a registration fee of ₹20 and a yearly subscription fee of ₹30 (renewal fee ₹30 after one year)
benefits_summary: Reimbursement up to ₹5,000 for purchasing a hearing aid.
